### Going . . . Not Knowing, Part Two
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-december-4-2017.html
Passage: Isaiah 42:16
Points:
- Following God often requires stepping into the unpredictable unknown without a visible map.
- Obeying divine promptings can look risky or virtually irrational to the surrounding world.
- Before taking a major leap of faith, verify that the direction aligns with Scripture and pure motives.
- Believers are pilgrims on earth called to remain unencumbered and ready to follow wherever God leads.

### Re-routed
Author: Van Walton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-3-2012.html
Passage: Isaiah 42:16
Points:
- Unplanned disruptions and painful life crises frequently provoke frustration and resistance.
- Difficult detours function as spiritual reconstruction projects through which God reshapes our lives.
- God assures believers that He guides them through unfamiliar darkness and will never forsake them.
- Even when the future path is unseen, believers can trust His leading through rough terrain.
